blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Pasay City Police Chief Col. Joselito de Sesto has been relieved of his post, the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) confirmed on Friday. “[He was] administratively relieved pending investigation,” NCRPO spokesperson Maj. Hazel Asilo said in a Viber message to the INQUIRER. READ: NCRPO chief urges cops to stay alert amid VP impeachment developments The NCRPO has not yet provided further information or the reason for the Pasay police chief’s relief. The INQUIRER also reached out to de Sesto, but he has yet to respond as of this writing. /jpv... Keep on reading: NCRPO relieves Pasay police chief; orders investigation
